## 🔗 Related Issue
Closes #2019 (Phase 2)

---

## 📝 Summary
Implemented Phase 2 ABAC support by adding a JSON-based policy condition evaluator and wiring `AccessPolicy.conditions` into `PolicyEngine.check_access()`. This adds condition-based decisions over subject/resource/context attributes with logical `AND/OR/NOT`, while preserving Phase 1 fallback behavior when no policy matches.
